From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Recap: Discovery call — NovaRetail x Redwood Inference

Hi Emily / Carlos,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so nothing gets lost in email: 

What we heard from you:
- Top priority: reduce per-request inference cost for customer-facing personalization flows while staying under a 200ms 95th latency in US regions.
- Pilot scope: 50k requests/day initially, ramp to 250k over 3 months if metrics hold.
- Security: must be able to pass SOC 2 and provide audit log samples; encryption keys managed via their KMS is preferred.
- Timeline: procurement/PO expected in April; proof-of-concept in May.

What Redwood can do / immediate asks:
- I attached the 6-slide discovery summary and an initial SOW draft (high level).
- We can provision a Dedicated pilot with an SLA-backed throughput profile and optional key-management integration.
- Next step: 30-min technical deep-dive with your infra team to validate KV-cache behavior and latency headroom.

Proposed slots: Tue 24th 10:00–10:30 PT, Wed 25th 14:00–14:30 PT. If those don't work, suggest a time that does.

If this looks off, please flag anything I misunderstood. If you're comfortable, a quick reply with one of these options is ideal:
1) Yes — schedule the tech call (pick a slot)
2) Needs more info — tell me what you'd like to see (benchmarks, SOC docs, cost model)
3) Not a fit right now — call it out and we'll stop follow-ups

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachments: NR-discovery-slides.pdf (presentation, 1.2MB); SOW-draft-v1.docx (document, 48KB)

Hi Kimberly — thanks for the clear recap and materials. I shared the slides with Carlos and our procurement lead. A couple quick notes from our side:

- This looks promising from a product fit perspective; Carlos will want to confirm the latency numbers under our realistic traffic shapes.
- Can you send SOC 2 + example audit log exports? Also a short note on how key rotation would work with our KMS.
- Procurement is "green light" for starting procurement conversations in the first week of April; they asked for an estimate of monthly committed cost for the pilot sizing you suggested.

I'll confirm availability for the tech call after Carlos weighs in — tentatively interested in Wed 25th.

Best,
Emily
